mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TRIP_MEMBER ( TRIP_ID, MEMBER_ID, INVITED_EMAIL, INVITE_TOKEN, ROLE, INVITED_AT ) VALUES ( #{tripId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{memberId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{invitedEmail, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{inviteToken, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{role, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, TO_CHAR(NOW(), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') )
mapper.select: SELECT TRIP_ID as "tripId", MEMBER_ID as "memberId", INVITED_EMAIL as "invitedEmail", ROLE as "role", INVITED_AT as "invitedAt", JOINED_AT as "joinedAt" FROM TRIP_MEMBER WHERE INVITE_TOKEN = #{inviteToken, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
mapper.update: UPDATE TRIP_MEMBER SET MEMBER_ID = #{memberId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, JOINED_AT = TO_CHAR(NOW(), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'), INVITE_TOKEN = NULL WHERE INVITE_TOKEN = #{inviteToken, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM TRIP_MEMBER WHERE INVITE_TOKEN = #{inviteToken, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
DELETE FROM TRIP_MEMBER WHERE JOINED_AT IS NULL AND TO_TIMESTAMP(INVITED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '3 days'
